scripts.format: npx prettier --write frontend && python -m ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: npx prettier --check frontend && python -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.check: npm run check:front && npm run check:back
scripts.fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix && python -m ruff check --fix backend && npm run format
scripts.check:front: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check frontend
scripts.check:back: python -m ruff check backend && python -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.fix:front: npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix && npm run format:front
scripts.fix:back: python -m ruff check --fix backend && npm run format:back
